name: google-workspace
description: Connects one Google account to this site with Google's own sign-in, then works with the Google files the person picks or this site creates (the drive.file permission, never the whole Drive). v1 ships Google Sheets: chat tools for spreadsheets and a form destination that appends submissions as rows. Products are turned on separately; turning one off stops its tools and deliveries without revoking the sign-in.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Sign in with Google once, then work with the spreadsheets you choose or create here.

credentialCards.title: Connect Google Workspace
credentialCards.label: Google Workspace
credentialCards.intro: Sign in with Google to read and update the spreadsheets you choose, create spreadsheets, or send form submissions to a sheet. No API key is needed.
usedFor: Reads and updates spreadsheets you choose, and creates new ones
Saves your site's form submissions to a spreadsheet
credentialCards.keyHint: Continue to Google's sign-in page and allow access to the files you use with this app (drive.file). Choose existing spreadsheets in Tovu's Google file picker after signing in.
credentialCards.permissions: Requests https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file: access only to files you choose or Tovu creates. It does not grant access to your whole Drive, Gmail or Calendar. Google Sheets must also be turned on in the plugin panel.

credentialCards.title: Use your own Google sign-in app
credentialCards.label: google-workspace/account OAuth client
credentialCards.intro: For a self-hosted site that cannot use Tovu's Google sign-in app, or an organisation using its own Google Cloud project. Save the app's client ID and client secret here, then sign in with Google. This does not replace your account sign-in.
usedFor: Uses your own Google sign-in app to connect this site to Google Workspace
credentialCards.keyHint: In Google Cloud, open Google Auth platform → Clients → Create client. Choose Web application for a hosted site, with this site's address plus /api/agent-plugins/connections/oauth/callback as the redirect URI, or Desktop app for Tovu desktop. Turn on the Sheets, Drive and Picker APIs. Paste the client secret here. Not a service-account key.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Google client ID
fields.hint: Required. Copy the client ID for the same Google sign-in app as the client secret.
